summary: Frontend E2E validation of P0 enhancements: (1) LoadPanel with activePlan real data, (2) Plan Gráfico header auto-fill, (3) 5 charts × 4 action buttons (Share/WhatsApp/Download/Expand). LoadPanel ✅ PASS — KPIs show real values (Carga aguda=109, Crónica=154, ACWR=0.71 Detraining, Tendencia=Decreciente RPE prom.0), no empty state, plan banner 'TEST Plan Fútbol ATR' visible with Deporte/Modelo/Semanas chips. Chart buttons ✅ PASS — 5 charts × 4 buttons = 20 buttons confirmed (chart-share-*, chart-whatsapp-*, chart-download-*, expand-chart-* for magnitud-de-carga-y-recuperación, volumen-e-intensidad, preparación-por-componentes, capacidades-físicas, duración-y-actividad). Header inputs ⚠ PARTIAL — 4/7 auto-filled correctly (input-sport='football', input-coach='Test User', input-duration='11 sem · 3 meses', input-model='ATR (Issurin)'). 3/7 NOT auto-filled: input-category='' (empty), input-athlete='' (empty), input-periodization-type='None' (literal 'None' string). chart-share click ⚠ PARTIAL — toast 'copiado' appeared BUT no request to /api/graphic-plan/share was observed in network (expected backend call did not fire). chart-download ✅ no console errors. chart-whatsapp ⚠ no popup event fired (may be suppressed by browser automation). expand-chart ⚠ [role='dialog'] NOT found in DOM after click (regression risk vs iteration_60 where dialog-mev-chart was found).

minor.issue: Frontend chart-share button shows success toast but does NOT appear to invoke this endpoint. Either the endpoint is not wired or the call is mocked client-side.

ui_bugs.issue: input-category renders empty. activePlan has no category field mapped OR fallback not applied.
input-athlete renders empty. athleteName prop from DashboardPage.js line 4185 may not be passed or activePlan.athlete_name is null.

input-periodization-type shows literal string 'None' instead of 'ATR' (model is ATR Issurin). useEffect at GraphicPlan.js ~545-578 likely stringifies a null/None Python value — should fallback to empty string or derived value from activePlan.periodization_type/model.

Clicking expand-chart-magnitud-de-carga-y-recuperación did not create a [role='dialog'] element in DOM. Possible regression of the expand Dialog for ChartSectionHeader charts (not to be confused with gp-mev-btn which worked in iteration_60).
No window.open popup or navigation detected when clicking chart-whatsapp-*. Handler may be incomplete.

integration_issues.issue: Toast 'Enlace de la gráfica copiado' appears (clipboard presumably written), but the POST /api/graphic-plan/share endpoint is NOT being invoked according to network listener. Main agent requirement was to call backend endpoint + copy URL + show toast — the backend call portion is missing.

issues: Persistent hydration error in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <tbody>/<tr>/<th>/<td>' — same issue reported in iteration_60. Stray <span data-ve-dynamic> wrappers leak into table children. Non-blocking but pollutes console.

action_items: Fix input-periodization-type auto-fill: GraphicPlan.js useEffect (~545-578) must not stringify None/null. Map activePlan.periodization_type (e.g., 'ATR' or 'Tradicional') or fallback to empty string.
Fix input-category auto-fill: ensure activePlan.category or athleteCategory prop (DashboardPage.js line 4185) is used and defaults to empty when absent, not missing entirely.
Fix input-athlete auto-fill: verify athleteName prop is being set on GraphicPlan from DashboardPage.js ~4185 and that activePlan has the athlete linked.
Investigate why expand-chart-* no longer opens a Dialog for the 5 main charts. Check ChartSectionHeader Maximize2 handler — may be that state wiring for modal is broken after recent refactor.
Wire chart-share button to actually POST /api/graphic-plan/share as per spec. Currently toast shows but no backend call fires.
Verify chart-whatsapp uses window.open with WhatsApp share URL; popup event did not fire in Playwright.
(Non-blocking) Remove stray <span data-ve-dynamic> wrappers inside <table>/<tr>/<tbody> to clear hydration warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: LoadPanel.js successfully bound to activePlan real data — KPIs rendering correct values. ✅
GraphicPlan.js ChartSectionHeader now has 4 action buttons per chart (20 total across 5 charts) with proper data-testid naming using slugified chart titles. ✅

GraphicPlan.js useEffect auto-fill (lines 545-578) has issues: 3 of 7 header inputs not hydrated — category, athlete, periodization-type. The 'None' string is particularly concerning (suggests Python backend None value serialized directly to JSON string).
chart-share handler appears to show UI success toast without actually invoking /api/graphic-plan/share backend endpoint — consumer contract deviation from spec.
Persistent hydration warnings '<span> cannot be child of <tbody>/<tr>/<th>/<td>' from data-ve-dynamic wrappers — same as iteration_60, still unresolved.

Potential regression: expand-chart-* does not open dialog while in iteration_60 the dialog-mev-chart opened fine (but that was gp-mev-btn, different button). Need to confirm if expand on the 5 main ChartSection charts ever opened dialogs or uses a different modal mechanism.

success_rate.frontend: ~60% (LoadPanel ✅, chart buttons count ✅, 4/7 header inputs ✅, 3/7 header inputs ❌, chart-share backend wiring ❌, expand-chart dialog ❌, chart-whatsapp popup ❌, chart-download ✅-no errors)

These need main-agent fix-pass.
rca_of_the_issue: Header auto-fill: GraphicPlan.js useEffect (~545-578) likely references activePlan.athlete / activePlan.category but those are null in TEST Plan Fútbol ATR seed; fallback logic missing — recommend null-coalesce to '' and derive periodization type from activePlan.periodization_model when periodization_type is absent. chart-share missing backend call: handler (GraphicPlan.js ~925-1017 offscreen-capture) likely calls navigator.clipboard.writeText with a hardcoded URL instead of POSTing to /api/graphic-plan/share to get a share_url then copying. expand-chart no dialog: either the Dialog open state is not being set in ChartSectionHeader click handler or the dialog component was removed/refactored — investigate the Maximize2 icon onClick wiring.
